Title: Azure Media Services fully integrated with Azure CDN

Body.Content: The integration of Azure Content Delivery Network (CDN) with Azure Media Services provides point-and-click provisioning of edge services. This helps speed your time to market and gives your content global reach. When you use Azure Media Services in coordination with Azure CDN, origin egress prices don’t apply. Azure CDN usage will be charged at standard Azure CDN pricing. Review the new pricing information on the Azure CDN Pricing page. For more information, please visit the Media Services page.
Body.Markdown:
The integration of Azure Content Delivery Network (CDN) with Azure Media Services provides point-and-click provisioning of edge services. This helps speed your time to market and gives your content global reach.

When you use Azure Media Services in coordination with Azure CDN, origin egress prices don’t apply. Azure CDN usage will be charged at standard Azure CDN pricing.

Review the new pricing information on the Azure CDN Pricing page. For more information, please visit the Media Services page.
